name: Empty Water Tube
summary: In Auberdine, the Empty Water Tube is ready to gather sacred moonwell water for the red crystal on Darkshore’s eastern cliffs.

sections.title: A Vessel for Blessed Waters
sections.body: Sentinels and scholars seek pure lunar essence to study the mysterious red crystal along Darkshore’s eastern ridge. Ordinary glass or flasks can contaminate consecrated water, so investigators visiting Auberdine’s moonwell receive this sealed vial for the work. They carry its filled contents up the mountain slopes to learn how the alien mineral responds to Elune’s magic.

sections.title: Probing Felwood's Shadow
sections.body: Felwood lies beyond the mountains east of Darkshore, poisoned by demonic corruption. Auberdine’s defenders suspect the ominous crimson monolith near the cliffs may be linked to that ruined forest. Researchers hope cascading moonwell water over its lattice will reveal the crystal’s inner structure without triggering a catastrophic release of the power trapped inside.

faq.q: What is the purpose of the Empty Water Tube?
aliases: why do i have empty water tube
what do i do with water tube
faq.answer: You receive the empty container in Auberdine to draw water from its moonwell for analyzing the bizarre red crystal on Darkshore’s eastern heights.

faq.q: Where should the tube be filled?
aliases: where do i fill empty water tube
faq.answer: Fill the tube by dipping it into the moonwell in Auberdine. The filled vessel becomes a Moonwell Water Tube.

faq.q: Why is moonwell water needed for the crystal?
aliases: what does moonwell water do to crystal
faq.answer: Moonwell water carries Elune’s potent, purifying magic. Scholars believe pouring it over the red crystal will reveal clues about its origin and composition.

faq.q: Why are Auberdine's residents worried about the crystal?
faq.answer: The crystal rests near the high ridge overlooking Felwood, a forest badly corrupted by the Burning Legion. Local watchers fear a link to that tainted wilderness could threaten Darkshore.

angles.text: As a Night Elf, handling consecrated moonwell water is a sacred duty. The Kaldorei revere moonwells as holy reservoirs blessed by Elune.
As a druid, you hold moonwells in deep reverence. You rely on their untainted waters to study anomalies and cleanse strange disruptions from corrupted lands like Felwood.
